title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase not seen at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase was not seen at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reason is for the absence of Chase to begin the week. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kingsley Eguakun promoted to Cardinals' 53-man roster
items.desc: The Cardinals promoted OL Kingsley Eguakun to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Eguakun will add depth on the offensive line for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Jones signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed WR Zay Jones to their practice squad.
items.impact: Jones will add depth in the wide receiver room for Arizona. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bobby Brown III (hand) listed questionable Thursday
items.desc: Bobby Brown III is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Brown logged full practices on Tuesday and Wednesday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Torricelli Simpkins III (ankle) ruled out Thursday
items.desc: Torricelli Simpkins III has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Simpkins will be sidelined on a short week for Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Akayleb Evans (triceps) ruled out Thursday
items.desc: Akayleb Evans has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Evans was unable to practice all week. He will be sidelined on a short week for Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Damien Lewis (knee) ruled out Thursday
items.desc: Damien Lewis has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Lewis was unable to practice all week. He'll be sidelined on a short week for Carolina.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) ruled out Thursday
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Packers.
items.impact: Phillips remains week-to-week with a hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) will practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ed Oliver will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Oliver is working his way back from a knee injury. His status remains uncertain for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. is not practicing to start the week on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jones remains day-to-day with a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylon Moore (concussion) back at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylon Moore returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore remains in concussion protocol. He will have till Saturday to clear all protocols for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) back at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kerby Joseph returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Joseph was expected to return at some point this season. His status for Sunday's game against the Vikings is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) practices Wednesday
items.desc: Mike Hall Jr. returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hall was back at practice for the first time since the start of October.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Myles Harden (hamstring) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Myles Harden is practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harden is working his way back from a hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jenkins continues to battle a knee injury. His status is uncertain for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tytus Howard (concussion) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Tytus Howard is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Howard is in concussion protocol. He will have to clear all protocols by Saturday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jared Verse (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jared Verse is not practicing on Wednesday due to a knee injury.
items.impact: Browns head coach Todd Monken said he doesn't anticipate Verse missing this week's game against the Steelers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adam Randall has practice window opened
items.desc: The Ravens opened the practice window for Adam Randall.
items.impact: Randall will have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Kennard signs with Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders signed LB Kyle Kennard to their practice squad.
items.impact: Kennard will add depth in the linebacker room for Washington.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Van Jefferson signs with Commanders' active roster
items.desc: The Commanders signed WR Van Jefferson from the practice squad.
items.impact: Jefferson will add depth in the Commanders wide receiver room with Terry McLaurin placed on IR. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terry McLaurin (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Commanders officially placed WR Terry McLaurin on injured reserve.
items.impact: McLaurin is out for the rest of the season with a torn patellar tendon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins was not seen at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hawkins is continuing to battle a knee injury. His status is uncertain for Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roquan Smith (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Roquan Smith was not seen at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith is continuing to battle a knee injury. His status is uncertain for Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vega Ioane (knee) not seen at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Vega Ioane was not seen at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ioane is expected to miss time with a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) takes part in individual drills Wednesday
items.desc: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles says WR Emeka Egbuka did individual drills in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bowles added that Egbuka needs to do more in practice on Thursday in order to progress toward a return to action.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) 'making good progress'
items.desc: Bucs head coach Todd Bowles said Antoine Winfield Jr. is making "good progress" after missing three games with a rib fracture.
items.impact: Winfield remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carnell Tate (shoulder) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Carnell Tate missed practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tate is dealing with a shoulder injury. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathan Taylor has not requested a trade
items.desc: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Jonathan Taylor has not requested a trade.
items.impact: This report comes after Josh Downs requested a trade. The Colts already moved Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner in trades this week. It remains up in the air if Taylor will be traded.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Stefon Diggs (undisclosed) to return to practice Thursday
items.desc: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said  Stefon Diggs will return to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Diggs is not practicing on Wednesday due to an undisclosed reason. He will be a full participant on Thursday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) to return to practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rashee Rice will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said everyone will practice on Wednesday, which includes Rice. His return would be huge for the Chiefs wide receiver room heading into a big divisional matchup against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jackson was seen running onto the practice field. It is a positive sign for his return in Week 8.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Braelon Allen to be limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Braelon Allen will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Allen and Breece Hall will both be limited to start the practice week. They'll need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) to be limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Breece Hall will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is a step in the right direction for the return of Hall. His status will need to continue to be monitored the rest of the week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Josh Downs requests trade from Indianapolis
items.desc: Josh Downs has requested a trade from the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Downs has been unsatisfied with his current role and is in a contract year. Spending that year on a team heading nowehere fast is not ideal, so trying to land on a team where you can build up your value and or get paid is the right idea. Now it's just seeing whether or not he will be dealt, and where.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) to see how practice week goes
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle is dealing with a chest injury going into the practice week.
items.impact: Waddle aggravated a previous chest injury in Sunday's game, and his status for Week 8 will be determined as the week progresses at practice. If Waddle misses Sunday's game, Troy Franklin and Marvin Mims Jr. could stand to see more snaps. This is a situation to monitor.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Justin Tucker signs with Chiefs
items.desc: Justin Tucker signed with the Chiefs' practice squad on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tucker has not kicked in the NFL since the 2024 season, following a much-publicized violation of the league's personal-conduct policy. He's now alongside fellow veteran kicker Harrison Butker in Kansas City. Butker has struggled a bit this season, and  Tucker could win out between the two. The situation should become clearer as the practice week moves forward.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Brandin Cooks snags one pass in Week 7
items.desc: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandin Cooks caught one pass for 13 yards for the second week in a row in a Week 7 loss to the Atlanta Falcons
items.impact: Cooks had another quiet week despite a season-high snap rate, appearing on 68% of the offensive plays. The 49ers are desperate for healthy wide receivers, but that doesn't mean they're going to make an impact. Quarterback Brock Purdy completed 27 passes - seven were caught by a wide receiver, a trend that could continue.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Noah Gray grabs three passes in Week 7
items.desc: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Noah Gray caught three passes for 44 yards on three targets in the team's Week 7 loss on Sunday Night Football.
items.impact: Gray has had a steady role in Kansas City's offense, playing at least 50% of the offensive snaps every week. Since the Week 5 bye, he has six catches for 97 yards - far from reliable for fantasy purposes, but a welcome contribution to a Kansas City offense missing wide receiver Rashee Rice.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Kayshon Boutte takes backseat in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Houston Texans wide receiver Kayshon Boutte caught one pass for 25 yards on two targets in the team's Week 7 loss to the New York Giants.
items.impact: Boutte recorded a season-low offensive snap rate in Week 7: 31%. This is notable given Xavier Hutchinson's involvement and Marvin Harrison's expected role growth. Jaylin Noel did suffer an injury, but Boutte has yet to surpass 40 receiving yards in a game and has seen a decrease in snap rate in each of the last two weeks.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring) placed on IR
items.desc: The New York Giants have placed running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. on injured reserve after suffering a hamstring injury in Week 7's win.
items.impact: Tracy suffered an injury during the Giants' win over the Houston Texans, a game in which he carried the ball six times for 15 yards and a score. The third-year running back had seen an uptick in snaps after playing 3% or fewer in the opening three weeks, scoring three touchdowns in the last two weeks. Cam Skattebo and Devin Singletary will lead the way for a New York running back room that bounced back in Week 7. Tracy is eligible to return in Week 13, given New York's Week 8 bye.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Erick All Jr. placed on IR, feared to have torn ACL
items.desc: The Cincinnati Bengals have placed tight end Erick All Jr. on injured reserve after suffering a knee injury in Week 7's win.
items.impact: All has appeared in all six games for Cincinnati this season, playing 32% of the snaps and contributing for the Bengals in multi-tight end sets. He caught eight passes, returning from an injury that sidelined him in 2025. All has dealt with several injuries in his career, and the fear is this could be another season-ending ACL tear.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Quenton Nelson traded to Seattle Seahawks
items.desc: Quenton Nelson has been traded to the Seattle Seahawks for a 2027 third round pick and a 2028 fifth round pick.
items.impact: Nelson was on an expiring contract and the Colts are staring at a rebuild, so selling Nelson makes sense. Seattle looks to have gotten a steal by sending a late day two pick and an early day three pick for Nelson, an eight time Pro-Bowlerand one of the more elite offensive linemen in the league. With Nelson on board and Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price set to return, the Seattle run game just got a lot better.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Eagles D/ST dismal in loss Monday
items.desc: The Eagles' D/ST failed to log a turnover or sack while allowing 38 points in Monday night's loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Philadelphia's defense fell flat on their face on Monday. They allowed Dallas to score 38 points over the course of the night, and they weren't able to log any big plays to help out their own offense. This unit is usually much better than this and should bounce back sometime in the near future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Elliott perfect in loss Monday
items.desc: Jake Elliott went 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Monday night's loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Elliott did his job on Monday night, knocking down all three of his attempted kicks in a loss to the Cowboys. He was left with a small fantasy total since they were all extra points, but he should bounce back sometime in the near future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Hollywood Brown racks up 30 yards Monday
items.desc: Hollywood Brown caught 2-of-5 targets for 30 yards in Monday's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: The veteran wideout had to step up with Philadelphia missing multiple key wideouts due to injury on Monday night. He was able to rack up 30 yards on the night, but he was limited to just two catches and didn't get into the end zone at all. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dameon Pierce finds end zone Monday
items.desc: Dameon Pierce rushed the ball 14 times for 47 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Pierce saw the most carries on the team on Monday night, with Saquon Barkley (hamstring) still having a limited workload in his return game. Barkley seems to have gotten banged up in this game as well, so if he's out next week, Pierce will prove to be startable in a lot of league formats in a matchup against the Commanders on Sunday night next week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darius Cooper quiet in loss Monday
items.desc: Darius Cooper caught 1-of-3 targets for just 17 yards in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: The Eagles weren't able to get Cooper going on Monday, as he finished with just 17 yards in this loss to their divisional rival. He will likely have a couple of boom games over the remainder of the season, but fantasy managers shouldn't trust him at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Makai Lemon plays well in loss Monday
items.desc: Makai Lemon caught 7-of-8 targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: The rookie finally had a high-production game, finishing with the most receptions, receiving yards, and touchdowns out of anyone on the team on Monday night. This performance was a good sign that he's not dead in the water after a slow start to the season, but he's unlikely to keep up at this pace when DeVonta Smith (hamstring) makes his return to the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Saquon Barkley gets banged up in return game Monday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley rushed the ball seven times for 62 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Monday night was Barkley's return game after he misses several weeks with a hamstring issue. He looked good with 62 yards and a touchdown in his limited action, but he tweaked his hamstring and suffered a new back issue that may affect him moving forward. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his injury status heading into Week 8.
